If you PUT a URI with slashes, it makes the intermediary nodes as peartree nodes once and for all.
I remember a ticket to allow this to be fixed in the repository, but I don't think it got fixed.
Maybe the importer should make sure the paths are built up, versus doing a PUT on the full path?
We would need to account for pairtrees, however.
I believe we can just sort the files with files before directories to fix this:
If the files are processed first, then the directories are created before their contents, avoiding accidental PairTree creation.
Sounds like a plan.

comments.body:
This is due to import ordering.

If you PUT a URI with slashes, it makes the intermediary nodes as peartree nodes once and for all.

I remember a ticket to allow this to be fixed in the repository, but I don't think it got fixed.

Maybe the importer should make sure the paths are built up, versus doing a PUT on the full path?
We would need to account for pairtrees, however.

I believe we can just sort the files with files before directories to fix this:

class FilesFirstComparator implements Comparator<File> {
    public int compare(final File f1, final File f2) {
        if (f1.isFile() && f2.isDirectory()) {
            return -1;
        } else if (f2.isFile() && f1.isDirectory()) {
            return 1;
        }
        return f1.compareTo(f2);
    }
}

If the files are processed first, then the directories are created before their contents, avoiding accidental PairTree creation.
That resolves the issue seen in https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2194 — though I'm not sure what the best way to test this would be.
As I noted on the other ticket, we also need to update the exporter to export all ancestral metadata so we can tell our peartrees from our real nodes.
There's a lot going on here, I'm going to break it up into smaller tickets as I identify individual problems.

Looks good, pending response to minor code review comments.
I assume this ticket is also completed: https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2215 ?
Yeah, I only made that ticket to cover the things I've fixed that don't directly relate to this ticket... and because I wasn't sure I'd fixed this ticket yet.

Michael Durbin, I created a PR against your feature branch. Please merge it into your branch if it is ok with you... then I will push this ticket through.
